policy: Additive whole-parent exclusions supported by targeted visual review of current assessment snapshots. Apply alongside the broad assessment matcher. Shared-context variants are explicitly marked conservative; unmatched pages are not certified clear.

reviewed_evidence.reason: The apple with X marking its centre of mass, mass 0.150 kg, stationary/resultant-force choices, and fall calculation from 0 to 4.9 m/s at 9.8 m/s2 all agree with the Foundation source. This parent was already reserved.

reviewed_evidence.test: 5. Forces and motion/2. Test before car safety etc/2024 Foundation test b4 car safety.pdf
reviewed_evidence.reason: Higher tier reuses the same distinctive apple/branch/leaf/X diagram, adding a stem label; its fall scenario uses 0.50 s, equivalent to the Foundation answer. It is not claimed to be the identical set of parts: the entire related parent is reserved to avoid revealing the assessment's shared context and answer relationship.

limitations: This targeted review supplements, rather than replaces, the broader 201-document assessment scan.

Nine named current tests were snapshotted. Native text was ranked across every page/paragraph block; selected image-only pages and all embedded images of the 2025 resit and 2026 final forces DOCX were viewed. This is not a full visual certification of every test page.
No generic shared phrase alone establishes source identity; weak matches for speed-of-sound recall, standard equations, and common answer instructions were not treated as confirmed sources.
A 2026 assessment must still be checked. The source-paper cutoff at 2026 does not make questions copied into a 2026 test safe.
The builder must apply whole-parent exclusions and the source-paper year cutoff independently.
